issue.title: Update Bob Mac Capture for explicit numeric close lists
issue.description: Update Bob Mac Capture presentation tests, pinned JSON fixtures, and capture-panel help for the approved close-selection behavior. Explain that any numeric list selects the listed Task Links, keep x0~K summary behavior aligned, and present unlisted Event Task links with their clock-based outcomes. Refresh affected source and outcome assertions from bob-cli JSON.

task_type_fields.impact: Mac Capture can teach the old selection rule or render a close from the new bob-cli contract inaccurately.
task_type_fields.repro: Feed the new bob-cli capture-parse and capture --dry-run JSON for x~2 and x0~2 into the Mac close presentation. Existing help says numeric suffixes only narrow scope, and pinned close/source expectations do not cover x~2 as explicit mode while unlisted Event Tasks retain clock outcomes.

issue.creation_reason: The approved close-selection plan changes the bob-cli capture contract for x~K. The Mac Capture repo has pinned help text and close presentation fixtures that need to match the new selection behavior; this follow-up is required by the plan.
